description: DocketDrafter gives attorneys a private, firm-specific document workspace in ChatGPT. It helps the user's agent reuse prior work, draft and revise legal documents in the firm's preferred court formatting, preserve version history, produce clean Word files and redlines, manage source documents, and track citation-checking work.
